xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4825: fix(models): replace dead MiMo/Groq/Cerebras ids; refresh MiniMax, xAI, Mistral, Meta, Kimi K2.8

plan.title: fix(models): replace dead MiMo/Groq/Cerebras ids; refresh MiniMax, xAI, Mistral, Meta, Kimi K2.8
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: A model-catalog refresh necessarily edits the same fixed registry files (providers.ts, settings.ts, model-deprecations.ts, model-capability-additions.ts, cost.ts, model-capability-class.ts, model-fallback.ts, modelCatalog.ts) once per provider, plus each provider's existing tests and docs. The operator already split the 2026-11 audit into three provider-grouped sibling issues (PAN-4825/4826/4827); splitting further would multiply merge conflicts in the same files without making any slice independently more reviewable. Items are per-provider vertical slices chained because they mutate the same files.

narratives.Problem: PROVIDERS.mimo, groq and cerebras ship only provider-retired model ids, including in tierModels and haikuModel, so every launch and every Claude Code subagent on those providers fails today. The MiMo connection test probes a dead id. MiniMax, xAI, Mistral, Meta (Muse) and Kimi entries are stale: current models are missing, and kimi-code/kimi-for-coding still reports K2.7 facts although the Kimi CLI now serves K2.8 Preview with a 1M window and low/high/max effort.
narratives.Proposal: Per provider, retire dead ids through single-hop MODEL_DEPRECATIONS rows to live replacements (MiMo V2.6, Groq openai/gpt-oss-120b|20b, Cerebras gpt-oss-120b), keep their historical capability/cost/class/routing rows, and repoint tierModels/haikuModel. Add the new current models (MiMo V2.6 x3, Groq gpt-oss x2, Cerebras gpt-oss-120b, mistral-large-4-0, grok-4.7, grok-4.3, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) with capability, cost, class, MODEL_PROVIDERS, FALLBACK_MAP and picker rows. Add a Groq slash carve-out ahead of the OpenRouter catch-all. Add max effort to Muse Wonder/Spark 1.3. Update kimi-code/kimi-for-coding to K2.8 Preview (1048576 context, canonical effort translated by kimi-effort.ts). Record every verified fact and every unverified skip in docs/MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md and the PR body. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4825.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Editing providers outside mimo, groq, cerebras, minimax, xai, mistral, meta, kimi (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DashScope, Z.AI, Nous, OpenRouter, QuantumLlama, OpenCode, Ollama belong to sibling issues or are untouched)
- Editing changelog.mdx
- Adding long-context tier logic to calculateCost in src/lib/cost.ts (tiers go in capability notes only)
- Adding 'minimal' to Overdeck's EffortLevel, or relaxing the Muse/Pi harness effort rows past xhigh
- Making omp/pi launch Groq slash ids (qualifying them as groq/openai/...)
- Changing tierModels for xai, mistral, kimi or meta; changing mistral-large-latest, mistral-small-latest or codestral-latest
- Setting supportsImages on any new model without a live probe; adding K2.8 Preview pricing
- Adding Groq qwen/qwen3-32b or qwen/qwen3.6-27b
- Changing the frontend timeline provider label for slash ids (Stage/HomePane/Timeline.tsx)
- Adding any hardcoded default/fallback model literal; growing src/lib/model-capabilities.ts past 1422 lines or src/dashboard/server/routes/settings.ts past 1104 lines; raising scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt

autoDecisions.summary: Retired ids stay in their type unions, routing lists, capability/cost/class rows; they leave models, haikuModel, tierModels, settings lists, MODEL_API_IDS and pickers.
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the issue's decision rule 2 and the existing OpenAI/Kimi retirement precedent; MODEL_CAPABILITIES is Record<ModelId,...>, so historical rows require the ids to stay in the union.

autoDecisions.summary: Groq ids openai/gpt-oss-120b|20b get an explicit carve-out before the slash OpenRouter catch-all in getProviderForModel and isOpenRouterModel.
autoDecisions.rationale: Without it both ids route to OpenRouter; qwen/qwen3.6-plus -> Nous is the existing precedent. Other openai/* ids keep routing to OpenRouter.

autoDecisions.summary: Add GroqModel, CerebrasModel and MistralModel unions (new ids only) to ModelId and extend ModelCapability.provider with groq|cerebras|mistral.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires capability rows for every new model, and MODEL_DEPRECATIONS targets are typed ModelId.

autoDecisions.summary: Mistral Large 4 uses the versioned API name mistral-large-4-0; mistral-large-latest is left unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: docs.mistral.ai lists mistral-large-4 and mistral-large-4-0; the versioned name keeps the price row stable. No official page says what mistral-large-latest resolves to.

autoDecisions.summary: Groq qwen-qwq-32b and gemma2-9b-it migrate to the issue's gpt-oss targets, not Groq's 2025 recommendations.
autoDecisions.rationale: Groq's Gemma recommendation (llama-3.1-8b-instant) is itself dead, and qwen/qwen3-32b would add an unrequested model; single-hop targets must be live. The ledger records the deviation.

autoDecisions.summary: MiniMax M2.7 stays live by default; the work agent retires it only if an official MiniMax page states it is retired or unavailable.
autoDecisions.rationale: Official pricing and models pages were silent on 2026-11-02; only third-party sources report a 2026-11-18 retirement. Issue rule 1 forbids acting on unofficial facts.

autoDecisions.summary: Muse gets max for muse-wonder-1.0 and muse-spark-1.3; minimal is not added.
autoDecisions.rationale: dev.meta.ai/docs/reasoning confirms max for those two models; Overdeck's EffortLevel union has no minimal. The Muse harness row still caps launches at xhigh.

autoDecisions.summary: Same-line successors inherit predecessor skill scores; new lines get the Muse 'unranked' pattern (all zero except context-length).
autoDecisions.rationale: Follows the additions-file convention and keeps new models opt-in so the skill router never picks them automatically.

autoDecisions.summary: New assertions go in a new test file src/lib/__tests__/model-catalog-refresh-pan-4825.test.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: Sibling issues PAN-4826/4827 edit model-catalog-audit.test.ts concurrently; a separate file avoids merge conflicts.

autoDecisions.summary: Only native kimi-code/kimi-for-coding changes to K2.8 facts; claude-route kimi-k2.7-code/kimi-for-coding keep 262144 context and no effort, notes only.
autoDecisions.rationale: The K2.8 facts were verified via the native CLI only; the claude route was not re-verified.
